result: I’d make empathy a prerequisite for power—not just a virtue, but something leaders, judges, and voters are required to practice. Everyone would have to regularly experience life through someone radically unlike themselves. Not to eliminate disagreement, but to make cruelty, indifference, and easy contempt much harder to sustain.
